transcript: This is 94 year old US Army Air Corps veteran Roy Beller making his way up the ladder of his family's pool slide. This great-grandfather's family was having a get-together for a 4th of July weekend when he said he wanted to go down the water slide and several family members mobilized to help him do just that. Beller's grandson stated in an interview that he watched his grandpa spend 15 years taking care of his wife that had developed Alzheimer's disease while elderly himself. He eventually lost his spouse of 67 years but his family were there to help keep him going and in good spirits. Beller's display of unconditional love inspires his family who are of course there for him through the ups and downs of life including the descent of a water slide.
metadata_caption: Family Helps 94-year-old Veteran Slide Down Waterslide
